key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Vision loss in the right eye for 2 days
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex
Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus

raw.rationale: Elevated Serum IgG4 levels and dense infiltrate of IgG4-positive plasma cells on pathology, consistent with IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Invasive fungal sinusitis
rejected.why: No evidence of fungal elements on pathology

rejected.label: Orbital pseudotumor
rejected.why: Presence of IgG4-positive plasma cells and elevated Serum IgG4 levels suggest a specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Giant cell arteritis
rejected.why: Patient's age and symptoms could be consistent, but lack of specific findings such as temporal artery involvement and absence of giant cells on pathology

rejected.label: Wegener's Granulomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatosis with polyangiitis or anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies (ANCA) positivity
